_comment: PROPERTY KIT PATTERN FILE — replace with a verified seed before first deploy.
_description: This file is a build-time baked availability snapshot. The fetch:availability-snapshot script calls your production /api/availability endpoint and writes the result here. Commit the result so cold-started autoscale instances answer instantly while the first live AppFolio fetch completes. The api-server treats seeds older than 48 hours as stale and sends an alert.
